# All Seasons Locksmith
> All Seasons Locksmith is a locally owned, bonded and insured mobile locksmith based in Harrisburg, PA. We serve Dauphin, Cumberland, Lebanon and surrounding Central Pennsylvania counties with automotive, residential, commercial and emergency locksmith service.

## Key facts
- Business name: All Seasons Locksmith
- Address: 1727 N 6th St STE 301, Harrisburg, PA 17102 (mobile service; in-store visits by appointment only)
- Phone: (223) 240-3505
- Hours: Sunday to Thursday 7:00 AM to 10:00 PM; Friday 7:00 AM to 6:00 PM; closed Saturday
- Service area: Harrisburg, the West Shore (Camp Hill, Mechanicsburg and nearby), the Lebanon Valley, and other Central PA towns

## Services
- [Automotive locksmith](https://allseasonslocksmith.com/services/automotive-locksmith/): car lockouts, key replacement, key fob and transponder programming, ignition repair
- [Residential locksmith](https://allseasonslocksmith.com/services/residential-locksmith/): lockouts, rekeying, lock repair and replacement, smart locks
- [Commercial locksmith](https://allseasonslocksmith.com/services/commercial-locksmith/): business lockouts, master key systems, access hardware
- [Emergency locksmith](https://allseasonslocksmith.com/services/emergency-locksmith/): lockouts, broken key extraction, safe opening
